question: En cáncer de pulmón, ¿qué 3 sponsors de la industria tienen más ensayos detenidos (terminados o retirados)? Contá solo al sponsor principal de cada ensayo.

attempts.query:
SELECT sp.name
FROM aact.studies s
JOIN aact.sponsors sp ON sp.nct_id = s.nct_id AND sp.lead_or_collaborator = 'lead'
WHERE sp.agency_class = 'INDUSTRY'
  AND s.overall_status IN ('TERMINATED','WITHDRAWN')
  AND s.nct_id IN (
    SELECT tc.nct_id FROM linking.trial_condition tc
    JOIN mesh.ancestor a ON a.id = tc.mesh_id
    JOIN mesh.descriptor md ON md.id = a.ancestor_id
    WHERE md.label = 'Lung Neoplasms')
GROUP BY sp.name
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT s.nct_id) DESC
LIMIT 3
